name: @ninebrains/docs
description: Documentation site for Ninebrains, built from the repo's docs/ directory.

scripts.build: node -e "for (const p of ['.astro', 'node_modules/.astro']) require('node:fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })" && astro build
scripts.typecheck: echo "docs: the content schema is validated by astro build"
